_comment: Operator-maintained, ORGANIZATION-level, CITED records of documented host/ASN conduct (court records, watchdog designations, a host's own stated policy). Each finding is public record with a source. These are facts about a HOST's conduct - never a claim about a client sharing that infrastructure, and never a person. An empty file means 'cannot assess' → Unknown, never 'clean'. Severity: high | medium | context.

entries.summary: Icelandic host built on a declared no-takedown / maximal-free-expression policy; alongside many legitimate privacy and activism clients, its infrastructure has hosted documented extremist and antisemitic content the host publicly refused to remove.

findings.label: Defended a documented antisemitic 'target list' in court
findings.detail: Hosted 'The Mapping Project' (mapliberation.org), which plotted addresses of Jewish and pro-Israel institutions and figures with a call to 'dismantle & disrupt' them. The ADL described it as a target list against the Jewish community and demanded removal in June 2022; 1984 refused and defended the site up to the Icelandic Court of Appeals (ruling December 2023), even dedicating an official subdomain to the affair.
sources: Anti-Defamation League (ADL) statement on The Mapping Project, 2022
Icelandic Court of Appeals (Landsréttur) ruling, December 2023

findings.label: Stated no-takedown policy for contested content
findings.detail: The host markets an explicit policy of not complying with removal demands even for severely contested content, placing it outside US/EU takedown norms.

flaggedCoHostedDomains.note: Domain name of an extremist character surfaced on the host's IP ranges. A domain NAME is an indicator, not proof of current content.
